strict-palette-contract.rationale: The parser declares exactly four stable palettes, owns four silhouettes per palette, rejects unknown fields, and fails closed on cross-palette silhouettes.

reusable-authored-coverage.rationale: Eight production districts reuse each palette exactly twice across overhead, tactical, and micro scales while remaining below the global generation bound.

deterministic-identity.rationale: Per-layer seeded streams deterministically reproduce palette, silhouette, color, dimensions, positions, yaw, and final instance matrices.

fixed-render-topology.rationale: All palettes share four named instanced geometry buckets with per-instance colors and the unchanged 72, 112, 192, and 256 quality caps.

low-readability.rationale: The 1280x720 Low capture and diagnostics preserve overhead and tactical representatives from all four palettes, plus the Bastion, units, terrain corridor, command feedback, and HUD within 72 instances.

authority-lifecycle.rationale: Palettes remain renderer-owned and terrain-read-only; quality cycling, authoritative height placement, disposal, warmed resources, and unchanged world hash pass.

regression-review.rationale: Focused unit and production browser lanes, refreshed LS-12 browser regression, the constrained complete repository check, final protected core match, and independent remediation review pass.

polish.summary: Primitive silhouettes may receive stronger slab and debris color separation or a four-palette comparison capture during later art refinement.
polish.reopenTrigger: Do not reopen LS-13 unless a palette loses tactical readability, deterministic ownership, or the fixed four-bucket performance boundary.
